text: Short selling means borrowing shares and selling them, hoping to buy them back cheaper later.

Paying off a mortgage early gives a guaranteed return equal to the interest rate.
Investing extra money in index funds historically returned about seven percent after inflation.

A traditional 401k reduces taxable income today; withdrawals in retirement are taxed as income.
An emergency fund should cover three to six months of essential expenses.
Unvested stock options may be accelerated, assumed or cancelled when a company is acquired.
Capital gains tax applies when you sell shares for more than you paid.
Renting can be cheaper than buying once maintenance, taxes and opportunity cost are included.
The mortgage interest deduction only helps if you itemize deductions.

Bonds pay fixed interest and are generally less volatile than stocks.
Credit card debt often carries interest rates above twenty percent.
